title: Salt Lake City Driving Tour
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Want to experience Salt Lake City but don’t have a lot of time? This is a great tour to see some of what is waiting for you in Salt Lake City! Learn about the history of the valley, the unique and eclectic people that call this area home and experience the architecture and outdoor space found in Utah’s Capital City. From its history of the Mormon Pioneers to a mining boomtown with its red-light districts, Salt Lake City has always had a multi-cultural and storied history that will come alive during this 3-hour excursion. Enjoy a more personal experience with our small-group tour (minimum of 2 guests required) and join us today. Your Adventure Awaits!
